- Initial release of the estimated-tax-safety-buffer skill.
- Adds guidelines for applying safe-harbor rules to estimated quarterly taxes, especially for self-employed, K-1, or variable-income clients.
- Outlines margin-of-safety approach: use prior-year (100%/110%) or current-year (90%) tax as buffer floor.
- Includes worked example for clarity and real-world application.
- Provides advisory variations, red flags, and verification checklist.
- Not intended for clients fully covered by W-2 withholding.
